_comment: SEC All-Conference selections, shown on all-conference.html grouped by sport. One entry per honoree per team. Name, school and (optional) position or event ONLY - no grade or class year, photos, contact details or stats, because this file is served publicly. 'year' is the school year, e.g. 2025-26. 'season' is Fall, Winter or Spring. 'sport' is a sport name as it appears on the schedule, e.g. Football or Girls Soccer. 'division' is the SEC division the list belongs to, e.g. American or Liberty (optional - leave it out for a sport picked conference-wide). 'team' is the heading the name is listed under, e.g. First Team, Second Team, Honorable Mention. 'school' should match the school's name on the School Athletic Websites page (e.g. Livingston High School) so its crest shows beside the name. 'intro' is an optional line shown above the lists. While 'selections' is empty the page shows a short 'posted after each season' line.
_divisionOrderNote: The order divisions are listed in on the page and in the Division picker. A division not listed here goes after these, A-Z.
